global_prompt: A single continuous cinematic shot in the same professional kitchen. The same middle-aged chef with gray stubble remains at the stainless steel counter, finishing a refined chocolate dessert. The shot maintains shallow depth of field, consistent lighting, realistic detail, and smooth camera movement.
local_prompts: The chef slowly withdraws his hand from the dessert, leaving the mint leaf neatly positioned on the frosting.
His fingers move away from the plate with care, avoiding any contact with the finished garnish.
The camera follows the retreating hand slightly, then settles back onto the plated dessert.
The chef lowers his hand to the counter beside the plate, keeping his attention on the dessert.
He studies the garnish placement with a calm, focused expression, making sure the dessert looks balanced.
The scene remains quiet and controlled, with the plated dessert centered and the chef still leaning over it.
